Intro:
GenWare offers a comprehensive range of Gastronorm pans, in stainless steel, polycarbonate and polypropylene. Also within this range are sealing lids for transportation. Polycarbonate ranges are ideal for salad bar presentation, and come in extensive depths and sizes. Polypropylene gastronorm containers offer excellent performance and value, and are particularly suitable for food storage use.
•Durable clear polycarbonate construction
•Perfect for food storage and great for food presentation
•Available in a range of GN sizes
•Stackable
•Do not use in a Bain Marie
•Temperature range:  -40 to 100C

Intro:
Antigo Cinza brings a quiet sophistication to the table. Each piece is shaped by natural kiln reactions and finished with a carefully developed glaze, making every item truly one of a kind. Fired at high temperatures, the collection reveals gentle shifts in tone and texture for a soft, contemporary look. Its muted grey palette offers a versatile canvas for vibrant dishes, perfect for modern dining spaces that value simplicity and style.
•Durable Fully Vitrified Porcelain: High-temperature firing creates a robust and long-lasting product, ideal for professional use
•Twice-Fired Process: Enhances strength, durability, and the unique glaze finish, ensuring each piece performs in demanding environments
•Conforms to Industry Standards: Meets BS4034 standards for vitrified hotelware, ensuring exceptional durability and quality in demanding environments
•Rolled Edges: Enhances durability and provides added chip resistance, making it ideal for hotel, restaurant, and foodservice applications
•Polished Foot: Minimises damage when stacked and stored, helping to maintain the integrity of each piece over time
•Unique Artisanal Finish: The natural kiln effects and spontaneous glaze reactions ensure every piece is truly one of a kind
•Inspired Matt Grey Hue: The soft, muted grey tones with delicate matt textures provide a contemporary and understated elegance

The Sardinia Series presents a comprehensive collection of expertly crafted designs, each tailored to elevate the presentation of wine, cocktails, martinis, and champagne. Sardinia caters to the diverse needs of high-end establishments by offering a range of forms and capacities, ensuring the precise and stylish serving of every drink. Crafted using a two-piece production technique, Sardinia is a testament to precision and innovation.
•Fully Tempered Glass: Excellent resistance to mechanical and thermal shocks, extending the life of the product by five times, compared with non-tempered glass
•Fine Rim: Combines elegance with functionality, offering a refined experience without sacrificing durability
•Crystal-Look, Durable Glass: Sturdy, practical glass with the elegance of crystal
•Two-Piece Construction: Ensures a refined elegance and reinforced strength
•Built to Last: Durable construction for everyday use in hospitality settings
•Dishwasher Safe: Easy to clean and maintain

Intro:
GenWare offers a comprehensive range of Gastronorm pans, in stainless steel, polycarbonate and polypropylene. The stainless steel range conforms to EN631 European standard, with a hard wearing electropolish finish. The range also comes in a complete and extensive choice of size and depth, with the relevant size and depth etched on each piece for easy identification. Also within this range are sealing lids for transportation. Polycarbonate ranges are ideal for salad bar presentation, and come in extensive depths and sizes. Polypropylene gastronorm containers offer excellent performance and value, and are particularly suitable for food storage use.
•Our range of GN air-tight containers are ideal for safe storage of food in an organised manner
•Tight fitting storage sealing lids are available to keep food fresh and are sold separately
•Temperature range:  -40 to 100C

Crafted from fully vitrified porcelain, the collection meets the stringent standards of BS4034, ensuring low water absorption for enhanced hygiene, superior resistance to thermal shock, increased strength, and excellent heat retention. Designed to withstand the rigours of professional kitchens, many items feature rolled edges and reinforced rims for added chip resistance.
GenWare Porcelain is the perfect choice for hotels, restaurants, and food service operations seeking reliable, high-performance tableware with timeless appeal.
• Durable Fully Vitrified Porcelain: High-temperature firing creates a robust and long-lasting product, ideal for professional use
• Twice-Fired Process: Enhances strength, durability, and the unique glaze finish, ensuring each piece performs in demanding environments
• Conforms to Industry Standards: Meets BS4034 standards for vitrified hotelware, ensuring exceptional durability and quality in demanding environments
• Rolled Edges: Enhances durability and provides added chip resistance, making it ideal for hotel, restaurant, and foodservice applications
• Polished Foot: Minimises damage when stacked and stored, helping to maintain the integrity of each piece over time
• Bright White Glaze: Made from specially selected clays for a brighter, whiter finish, offering exceptional presentation while remaining a practical choice compared to other porcelain alternatives
• Durable Glaze: Durable glaze prolongs the life of the product and improves stain resistance

The versatile range includes an extensive selection of plates, bowls, and beverage items, perfectly complemented by service pieces to create a complete table setting.Crafted from fully vitrified porcelain, the collection meets the stringent standards of BS4034, ensuring low water absorption for enhanced hygiene, superior resistance to thermal shock, increased strength, and excellent heat retention. Designed to withstand the rigours of professional kitchens, many items feature rolled edges and reinforced rims for added chip resistance.GenWare Porcelain is the perfect choice for hotels, restaurants, and food service operations seeking reliable, high-performance tableware with timeless appeal.
•Durable Fully Vitrified Porcelain: High-temperature firing creates a robust and long-lasting product, ideal for professional use
•Twice-Fired Process: Enhances strength, durability, and the unique glaze finish, ensuring each piece performs in demanding environments
•Conforms to Industry Standards: Meets BS4034 standards for vitrified hotelware, ensuring exceptional durability and quality in demanding environments
•Rolled Edges: Enhances durability and provides added chip resistance, making it ideal for hotel, restaurant, and foodservice applications
•Polished Foot: Minimises damage when stacked and stored, helping to maintain the integrity of each piece over time
•Bright White Glaze: Made from specially selected clays for a brighter, whiter finish, offering exceptional presentation while remaining a practical choice compared to other porcelain alternatives
•Durable Glaze: Durable glaze prolongs the life of the product and improves stain resistance

The versatile range includes an extensive selection of plates, bowls, and beverage items, perfectly complemented by service pieces to create a complete table setting.Crafted from fully vitrified porcelain, the collection meets the stringent standards of BS4034, ensuring low water absorption for enhanced hygiene, superior resistance to thermal shock, increased strength, and excellent heat retention. Designed to withstand the rigours of professional kitchens, many items feature rolled edges and reinforced rims for added chip resistance.GenWare Porcelain is the perfect choice for hotels, restaurants, and food service operations seeking reliable, high-performance tableware with timeless appeal.
•Durable Fully Vitrified Porcelain: High-temperature firing creates a robust and long-lasting product, ideal for professional use
•Twice-Fired Process: Enhances strength, durability, and the unique glaze finish, ensuring each piece performs in demanding environments
•Conforms to Industry Standards: Meets BS4034 standards for vitrified hotelware, ensuring exceptional durability and quality in demanding environments
•Rolled Edges: Enhances durability and provides added chip resistance, making it ideal for hotel, restaurant, and foodservice applications
•Polished Foot: Minimises damage when stacked and stored, helping to maintain the integrity of each piece over time
•Bright White Glaze: Made from specially selected clays for a brighter, whiter finish, offering exceptional presentation while remaining a practical choice compared to other porcelain alternatives
•Durable Glaze: Durable glaze prolongs the life of the product and improves stain resistance

Intro:
The GenWare professional chef knife collection consists of a wide choice of knives and accessories available through both GenWare and the German Knife manufacturer, Giesser. GenWare black-handled and colour coded range of professional chef knives offer a full tang blade, with razor sharp molybdenum steel blade, which conforms to BS8442-5, giving initial sharpness and cutting edge retention. Our Knife Sharpener is a great alternative to a traditional sharpening steel and features a two stage process designed to rejuvenate blunt knives with a razor sharp blade. Giesser knives, designed and manufactured in Germany, provide an industry leading combination of initial sharpness, cutting edge retention and value for money.
•Use to rejuvenate blunt knives to a razor sharp blade
•Two stage sharpening design with coarse and fine
•Non-skid feet for stability and safe sharpening
•Ergonomically designed soft grip handle for comfort and to prevent hand from slipping
•Not suitable for serrated knives

Intro:
The GenWare professional chef knife collection consists of a wide choice of knives and accessories available through both GenWare and the German Knife manufacturer, Giesser. GenWare black-handled and colour coded range of professional chef knives offer a full tang blade, with razor sharp molybdenum steel blade, which conforms to BS8442-5, giving initial sharpness and cutting edge retention. Larger knives have soft grip handles which give comfortable and positive handling. Knife sets offer a pre-selected range of knives, ideal for chef colleges, students and professional chefs. Knife cases are designed to carry knives and knife sets safely, offering protection from damage and injury. Our Knife Sharpener is a great alternative to a traditional sharpening steel and features a two stage process designed to rejuvenate blunt knives with a razor sharp blade. Giesser knives, designed and manufactured in Germany, provide an industry leading combination of initial sharpness, cutting edge retention and value for money.
•Designed for lifting and turning carefully when cooking, or dressing dishes for neater presentations
•Round tip tweezers and long construction for easier to control and better handling
•Stainless steel construction provides good resistance to staining and maintains an excellent finish

Intro:
Rustic Blue Stoneware offers a perfect blend of individuality and style, bringing a touch of artisanal charm to any dining experience. Featuring a rich, deep blue hue with subtle earthy undertones, Rustic Blue Stoneware is designed to enhance the visual appeal of every dish, making it an ideal backdrop for the vibrant and colourful nature of global cuisines. From the bold flavours of South American specialties to Spanish tapas and fresh Mediterranean cuisine, this collection provides a striking canvas for creative food presentation. Each piece showcases a unique reactive glaze, ensuring no two items are exactly alike, adding authenticity and depth to the dining experience. Durable and practical, Rustic Stoneware is designed to withstand the rigors of professional kitchens, offering both style and strength for restaurants, cafes, and hospitality venues looking to create a lasting impression.
•Durable Stoneware: Made from high-quality stoneware to withstand the rigors of a professional kitchen
•Twice-Fired Process: Enhances strength, durability, and the unique glaze finish, ensuring each piece performs in demanding environments
•Rolled Edges: Enhances durability and provides added chip resistance, making it ideal for hotel, restaurant, and foodservice applications
•Polished Foot: Minimises damage when stacked and stored, helping to maintain the integrity of each piece over time
•Unique Artisanal Finish: The natural kiln effects and spontaneous glaze reactions ensure every piece is truly one of a kind
•Inspired Blue Hue: The deep blue finish with subtle earthy undertones provides a stunning backdrop for the vibrant and colourful nature of global cuisines

A unique glaze formula, combined with high-temperature firing, ensures no two pieces look exactly alike, with variations in color intensity creating a truly distinctive appearance. The Pearl Terra Porcelain collection draws inspiration from the iridescent hues and natural beauty of pearls with it's blend of soft whites, greens and blues which shimmer and shine. Each piece in the collection boasts a luxurious and unique pearlescent finish which adds a touch of opulence to culinary presentation perfect for a spectrum of dishes and cuisines.
•Durable Fully Vitrified Porcelain: High-temperature firing creates a robust and long-lasting product, ideal for professional use
•Twice-Fired Process: Enhances strength, durability, and the unique glaze finish, ensuring each piece performs in demanding environments

•Rolled Edges: Enhances durability and provides added chip resistance, making it ideal for hotel, restaurant, and foodservice applications
•Polished Foot: Minimises damage when stacked and stored, helping to maintain the integrity of each piece over time
•Stackable: Optimises storage space, making it easy to stack securely without risking damage, perfect for busy kitchens
•Unique Artisanal Finish: The natural kiln effects and spontaneous glaze reactions ensure every piece is truly one of a kind
•Inspired Pearl Hue: The blend of soft whites, greens, and blues captures the iridescent beauty of natural pearls
•Complete the Look: Pairs beautifully with other items in the Terra Porcelain range for a cohesive and stylish tabletop presentation
